# DS-QM206-BOUNDARY-SYNTHESIS

Source distinct matrices with equal diagonals do not by themselves define a non-full/non-faithful category functor. This step supplies a genuine small additive-monoid map C4->C4, k->2k: it respects composition, identifies 0 and 2, and misses 1 and 3. It is a toy one-object-category interpretation only; no GTOC->Hilb functor or pointer basis is constructed.

Supported: Actual C4 image/kernel and all composition controls are exact; additive homomorphism, collision and missed-arrow statements are kernel checked.

Remaining: Define the intended GTOC/Hilb categories and actual descent functor, prove its properties and discharge the QM205 pointer-basis stub. The toy map is not that functor.
